name: Kenya
shortSummary: Kenya serves as India's key gateway to East Africa, with historic ties dating to 19th-century Indian railway labour migration and a substantial resident Indian-origin community today.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: Kenya anchors much of India's trade and development engagement with East Africa.
A long-settled Indian-origin community remains prominent in Kenyan business and civic life.

recentDevelopments.title: East Africa gateway role continues
recentDevelopments.description: Kenya remained India's primary commercial and diplomatic gateway to East Africa, with steady pharmaceutical and engineering-goods trade.
recentDevelopments.whyItMatters: A stable, historically rooted relationship without major recent shifts.

historicalEvents.title: Establishment of Diplomatic Relations
historicalEvents.description: India establishes a diplomatic mission in Nairobi even prior to Kenyan independence, reflecting the historic Indian community presence dating to railway construction in the 1890s.
